jobs.title: CX Operations Analyst
jobs.jd_full:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

As a CX Operations Analyst, you will own key operational processes related to Partner Services (SOWs, invoicing, renewal processes, system access) while also providing data analysis, workflow automation, and AI builds that support multiple functions including TAM, Solutions and Support/CX. You are the person who keeps critical operational machinery running smoothly while continuously improving how it works.

This role works across the full CX Ops team and partners with stakeholders in TAM, Solutions, Support, Partner Services, Finance, and GTM Systems. You'll collaborate closely with other CX Ops team members on initiatives while taking direct ownership of your assigned processes and analytical deliverables. The right person for this role is detail-oriented, analytically strong, and energized by building automations and AI solutions that eliminate manual work. This role connects directly to our mission of making every CX team faster, better-informed, and more consistent through operational excellence. If you are an AI native, proactive, data-driven individual who thrives in a fast-paced environment, this role is for you!

About the Role

Professional Services Operations

  • Operationalize partner delivery quality and customer outcomes measurement to ensure accountability regardless of delivery model

  • Support the end-to-end SOW management process for Partner subcontracting: creation, tracking, amendments, and closure in coordination with Partner Services leadership and Finance

  • Execute partner invoicing workflows: validate submissions, process approvals, track payments, and resolve discrepancies

  • Enable partner system access: provisioning, de-provisioning, and ongoing governance of partner access to internal tools and customer environments

  • Support capacity planning and resource assignments as the business scales

  • Maintain accurate records and documentation for all partner operational processes, ensuring audit readiness and clear escalation paths

Workflow Automation & AI Builds

  • Build, ship, and iterate on AI-driven workflows that enhance and automate internal processes, customer health inspection, risk detection, engagement management, services delivery lifecycle, quality measurement, and customer experience across TAM, Solutions and CX

  • Develop AI agents and AI-assisted tools in collaboration with team members, contributing to the team's broader automation roadmap

  • Actively leverage AI in daily work: data analysis and modeling, stakeholder communications, problem-solving and workflow orchestration

  • Facilitate the adoption of new tools and processes, including AI and automation platforms, to drive productivity across the organization

  • Apply strong judgment to validate AI outputs, manage risk, and improve the repeatable systems the team uses

  • Stay current with AI developments relevant to CX operations and translate learnings into solution improvements

Data Insights

  • Extract key business insights from qualitative and quantitative data, identify risks and opportunities, and inform programs that drive revenue retention, expansion, quality, and operating leverage

  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards in Salesforce, ClickUp and Hex that support TAM, Solutions, and Partner Services leadership with operational visibility

  • Perform ad hoc data analysis to answer business questions, surface trends, and support decision-making by CX Ops team members and stakeholders

  • Support renewals and retention analysis with data extraction, formatting, and pattern identification

Cross-Functional Programs

  • Own specific deliverables within larger strategic initiatives to optimize and transform customer engagement, services delivery, and internal collaboration processes

  • Support senior CX Ops team members on projects spanning TAM, Solutions, and Partner functions, executing assigned works with high quality and reliability

  • Respond to ad hoc operational requests from CX Ops leadership and stakeholders with timely, accurate deliverables

  • Embody a culture of rapid innovation and experimentation across playbooks to drive customer outcomes and enhanced experience

About You

  • 3+ years in Operations, Analytics, or a related role, preferably in a SaaS, customer-facing, or GTM environment

  • Demonstrated track record of building and deploying AI-powered workflows that delivered productivity gains, better decision quality, cleaner execution, improved data signals, or increased customer reach

  • Track record of supporting technology-enabled business process transformations, with an emphasis on strategic application of AI and agentic solutions

  • Proficient in managing and analyzing data, including building reports and scenario analysis models, as well as leveraging business intelligence tools to drive leadership strategy

  • Effective at collaborating with cross-functional stakeholders across global regions, reaching consensus, and driving change together

  • Proficient with Salesforce, Gong, ClickUp, Hex, Tableau, Google Apps Script and comparable platforms

  • Direct experience with a SaaS business model, customer journey, and core KPIs in a high-growth, global environment

  • Knowledge of professional services and customer success methodology, processes, tools, and metrics

  • Strategic thinker with a bias for action - hands-on, scrappy, and able to take projects to the finish line

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile
jobs.jd_full:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser, and Pocket, a service for keeping up with the best content online. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders - only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About this team and role:

We’re looking for a hands-on Mobile Product Manager with a primary focus on Firefox for iOS, while also contributing across mobile (including Android).

This role is about building a better browser, turning downloads into loyal users, and creating experiences that truly stand out. If you’ve shipped mobile apps, obsess over details that improve everyday use, and love turning user insights into real improvements, this is a great opportunity to drive impact at Firefox.

What you’ll do:

  • Build a fundamentally better browser experience: fix bugs, refine UI and navigation, improve downloads, menus, performance, and all the small details that make Firefox noticeably better for users who care about privacy, quality and reliability.
  • Drive strong activation and retention: focus on the new-user journey, quickly hooking people after they install the app, understanding where they drop off, and relentlessly optimizing the funnel through data, testing and iteration.
  • Deliver differentiating features and experiences that make Firefox stickier for key user groups, the kinds of things others can’t or won’t build.
  • Work closely with engineers, designers, data science and TPMs to ship high-impact improvements while balancing user needs, technical constraints, privacy and performance goals.
  • Stay deeply connected to real users: track App Store trends and discussions, test apps hands-on, analyze reviews and analytics, and turn those insights into concrete enhancements for Firefox on iOS and Android.
  • Monitor app health in App Store Connect and Google Play Console (crashes, ANRs, ratings) and support acquisition/retention efforts through ASO, store listings and growth experiments.
  • Adapt and optimize Firefox for global markets (Europe, Japan, Asia etc.), keeping cultural differences and local realities like data constraints in mind.

What you'll bring:

  • Proven Shipping Experience: Hands-on experience launching or managing apps on the iOS App Store and/or Google Play Store, with clear impact on user experience and metrics.
  • Execution Focus: A strong track record of delivering features and improvements under deadlines through effective collaboration with engineering, design and cross-functional partners.
  • Mobile & Browser Fluency: Deep understanding of iOS (and ideally Android) ecosystems, app store policies and web browser technologies, with genuine passion for what makes a great browsing experience.
  • Data-Driven Iteration: Comfort using analytics, funnels, A/B testing and user feedback to improve activation, retention and overall product quality.
  • User Obsession: Natural habit of studying apps, following trends on platforms like X/Twitter and Reddit, and testing experiences yourself to uncover opportunities.
  • Global & Growth Mindset: Interest or experience growing products in international markets with sensitivity to local user needs.
  • Bonus:
    • Experience with mobile browsers or privacy-focused products.
    • History of meaningfully scaling an app’s user base.
    • Currently maintaining your own side project or app on the App Store or Google Play.

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Quarterly well-being stipend
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at hiringaccommodation@mozilla.com to request accommodation.

We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race (including hairstyle and texture), religion (including religious grooming and dress practices), gender, gender identity, gender expression, color, national origin, pregnancy, ancestry, domestic partner status, disability, sexual orientation, age, genetic predisposition, medical condition, marital status, citizenship status, military or veteran status, or any other basis covered by applicable laws. Mozilla will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics or any other unlawful behavior, conduct, or purpose.

About the role

The Project Manager leads the execution of projects. This individual is responsible for the creation of the project plan based on information provided in the strategy and the determination of job level. He or she owns the process inception to completion, including participation in budget determination, creation of project schedule, managing resources for deliverables, raising red flags as issues arise and ensuring adherence to the approval process.

What you’ll do:

  • Responsible for the creation of Scope of Work (“SOW”)
  • Collaborates with all agency teams to establish effective project plans, staff plans, forecast upcoming work and allocate resources
  • Manages effective, efficient workflow of all projects on assigned accounts
  • Develops timelines and advises on estimates; manages projects to remain on time and budget; flags timing and budget concerns to course correct
  • Schedule and lead project kick-off meeting (as it relates to schedule, job level, folder structure and location, SOW, creative assets, etc.)
  • Work with internal team to define program requirements and system specifications. Work with client on as-needed basis
  • Initiate and conduct formal internal review meetings to secure creative approvals
  • Initiate and conduct formal team status meetings, document risks and issues for internal purposes
  • Maintain daily communications with team members on all projects
  • Work closely with the team to determine and understand daily project status
  • Ensure that issues and risks are anticipated, identified and properly escalated and resolved. Seek final resolution on all issues so projects do not stall or fall out of scope without warning
  • Conduct internal copy/layout reviews with core team and ensure all assets are routed internally, with specific attention to required creative and proofreading approvals
  • Ensure adequate amount of time, whenever possible, for the routing and review of materials
  • Facilitate presentations and review of final asset with client and provide recommendations pertaining to budget, timing, production, etc.
  • Identify out-of-scope activities
  • Manage the financial tracking process for the project (create job status report, attend accounting meetings, maintain the estimate by reallocating hours as necessary, flag overages, identify delays that may affect budget, etc.)
  • Takes ownership of and enforces agency processes by providing meaningful feedback to all teams
  • Analyzes and recommends process improvements to enhance efficiency, including systems and/or software recommendations
  • Tactful, yet assertive communication style; able to foster positive relationships with agency teams
  • Provides meaningful performance input for other employees in all departments
  • Maintains a high level attention to detail
  • Maintains a professional and positive attitude
  • Seeks out additional opportunities to expand experience and cultivate expertise
  • Performs other duties as assigned

About you:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • 2-5 years project or account management experience in Pharma agency environment
  • Experience with timeline development and budget management required
  • Ability to establish and build productive relationships with diverse personalities
  • Must be self-motivated, professional, detail-oriented and possess excellent communication skills
  • Comfortable working under pressure within tight deadlines while maintaining a positive attitude
  • Must have an enthusiastic desire to continuously learn, evolve and innovate
  • PC, MS Office Suite software experience required
  • Workfront and Jira experience required

$75,000 - $85,000 a year

What we can offer

You will receive a 401K plan with an employer match contribution up to 4% (immediately vested), as well as life insurance, disability coverage, and medical, dental, and vision plans for peace of mind. Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid and remote work, along with the option to work from anywhere across the globe two weeks each year. We provide 20 vacation days plus one personal well-being day, recognise 9 public holidays, along with gifted end-of-year holidays and an early Summer Friday finish in June, July, and August.

Access free counselling through our employee assistance program and personalized health support. Our enhanced maternity, paternity, family leave, and fertility policies provide support across every stage of your family-planning journey. You can also benefit from continuous opportunities to professionally develop with on-demand training, support, and global mobility opportunities across the business.

These tools assist our Talent team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please review our candidate privacy policy.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.jd_full:
MongoDB’s Incident & Escalation Management (IEM) function coordinates cross-functional responses to critical customer situations and drives improvements to how we respond over time. We’re looking for a Senior Program Manager to strengthen the function’s ability to deliver its program priorities consistently across regions through focused planning, disciplined execution, clear visibility, and dependable follow-through.

As an execution partner to IEM leadership, you’ll help turn strategic priorities and operational learnings into a measurable book of work. You’ll establish clear plans, ownership, operating cadences, risk visibility, and follow-through, while bringing an informed external perspective on relevant industry practices. You’ll partner with the IEM team and stakeholders across Technical Services, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Sales, and other teams in the Americas, Asia Pacific, and EMEA.

This is a program-management role - not an incident commander or technical investigator role. Functional leaders and incident responders retain accountability for strategy, policy, technical decisions, people leadership, and live operational response. You’ll own the execution system around prioritized work so leaders and subject-matter experts can focus on customers, technical judgment, incident leadership, and their teams.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Toronto for our hybrid working model.

What you’ll do

  • Own the IEM program of work and its supporting materials, maintaining a clear roadmap of outcomes, priorities, owners, milestones, dependencies, capacity considerations, commitments, and decisions
  • Partner with IEM leaders and sponsors to identify and prioritize strategic focus areas, assess opportunities to mature the function, and recommend practical improvements aligned with relevant industry practices
  • Turn ambiguous needs into scoped, measurable work. Clarify outcomes, sequence milestones, establish accountable owners, document decisions and delivery expectations, and coordinate technical and cross-functional reviews
  • Drive delivery across Technical Services, Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Sales, and partner teams. Clarify accountability and handoffs, resolve dependency gaps, and surface blockers, capacity constraints, and resourcing risks early—with options and recommendations
  • Establish and run planning, program-review, and risk-review cadences. Keep backlogs and program records current and decision-ready, track commitments, facilitate decisions, and follow agreed actions through closure
  • Connect IEM program works with the Customer Organization’s wider PMO, aligning planning, governance, dependencies, and reporting to ensure organizational alignment and visibility
  • Help translate recurring incident and escalation patterns, post-incident findings, customer-impacting gaps, and corrective actions into prioritized improvement work with owners, timelines, milestones, and verifiable closure criteria. Coordinate root-cause analysis completion and customer incident-report delivery with clear ownership and quality expectations
  • Advance incident-response and escalation practices, including frameworks and playbooks, readiness, communications, training, simulation exercises, post-incident review, and consistent implementation across teams and regions
  • Partner with data and tooling teams to improve operational instrumentation, metrics, reporting, workflow integration, and automation. Help ensure AI-enabled workflows are appropriately governed, measured, and human-reviewed.
  • Mature program reporting by refining outcome and health measures, improving data quality and consistency, establishing baselines, and turning operational data into actionable insights - not simply reporting activity or optimizing a single response-time metric
  • Prepare concise updates, requirements, specifications, operating proposals, decision records, and executive-ready summaries that make progress, trade-offs, risks, and decisions clear
  • Coordinate readiness and adoption so approved changes to processes, tooling, roles, communications, and operating procedures are understood, operationalized, and sustained

What success looks like

  • Priority initiatives have clear outcomes, accountable owners, realistic milestones, active risk tracking, and reliable follow-through
  • Leaders have an accurate, timely view of program health, delivery risks, dependencies, capacity constraints, and decisions needed
  • Post-incident and post-escalation learning becomes prioritized, durable improvement; corrective actions have clear owners and do not remain open-ended
  • Readiness, handoffs, communications, and closure practices become more consistent and measurable across teams and regions
  • Escalation Managers, Incident Commanders, and technical experts spend less time coordinating program work and more time applying their expertise to customers, incidents, and teams
  • Program measures guide decisions and improvement, while execution reliability and stakeholder confidence increase

How success will be assessed

The role will be evaluated on program health and operational outcomes - not meeting or status-report volume. Measures will be baselined during the first 60–90 days and refined with leadership. They may include:

  • The share of priority initiatives with clear outcomes, accountable owners, milestones, and active risk tracking
  • Initiatives and process improvements completed and adopted
  • Closure rate and aging of post-incident and post-escalation actions, overdue actions, and unresolved dependencies
  • Evidence that recurring incident and escalation patterns are being addressed through durable process, tooling, or product changes
  • Stakeholder confidence in visibility, coordination, and decision follow-through
  • Sampled estimates of coordination time returned to operational leaders and subject-matter experts

What you’ll bring

  • 7–10 years of progressive program or project management experience, with a track record of growing responsibility - from coordinating smaller initiatives to leading complex, cross-functional programs. Experience outside the technology sector is welcome
  • Significant experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in a global enterprise or similarly demanding environment, delivering through a matrix rather than relying on direct authority
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response, major-incident management, customer escalations, crisis management, service operations, trust & safety, or closely related operational programs at scale. You understand the lifecycle from detection and triage through coordination, communication, mitigation, review, and follow-through
  • A track record of building or improving operational programs - not only tracking projects - including governance, operating cadences, roles and handoffs, readiness, metrics, and continuous-improvement mechanisms
  • Strong project and program-management fundamentals, including program prioritization, scope and outcome definition, sequencing, dependency and risk management, capacity awareness, backlog discipline, stakeholder alignment, delivery governance, and change adoption
  • Experience establishing useful operating cadences and decision-ready reporting, and working with operational data to set baselines, interpret trends, and turn evidence into practical recommendations
  • The ability to structure ambiguous requests into clear requirements, operating proposals, decision records, and measurable work.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including concise updates for senior leaders and clear coordination across technical and customer-facing teams.
  • Sound judgment in high-pressure, ambiguous environments; a collaborative, calm approach to resolving blockers; and the ability to create accountability without adding unnecessary process.
  • Experience working across global teams, time zones, and organizational boundaries, and with program or delivery-management tools
  • A recognized program or project management qualification, such as PMP or PRINCE2, is preferred

Helpful experience

  • Experience in enterprise SaaS, cloud services, technical support, production operations, or another customer-facing technology organization
  • Familiarity with highly technical platforms, distributed systems, databases, reliability, or service-management practices
  • Experience with post-incident improvement programs, corrective-action tracking, operational dashboards, incident metrics, or executive reporting
  • Experience improving incident-management tooling, communications workflows, workflow automation, or responsibly governed AI-enabled operations
  • Experience coordinating global teams across regions, time zones, and follow-the-sun operating models

What you can expect in your first 90 days

  • First 30 days: Build relationships with sponsors, functional leaders, and program owners. Understand the operating model, active program work, commitments, decision forums, systems of record, reporting, and key measures
  • By 60 days: Reconfirm priorities, outcomes, owners, sequencing, dependencies, capacity constraints, and delivery expectations. Review risks, blockers, post-incident actions, and recurring coordination gaps; establish an initial baseline for program health and measures
  • By 90 days: Present a prioritized program overview, baseline assessment, risk and dependency summary, initial measure results, and recommendations for the next two quarters. Establish or strengthen the operating cadence, reporting, decision forums, and escalation paths

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.
